about_the_game:
CLOSER TO NATURE

Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

FRIENDS FUR-EVER

A clever Maine Coon or a lively Pomeranian? Or are you more of a turtle person? Adopt dogs, cats, rabbits, hamsters, snakes, frogs, and many more! Decorate your living room around a colorful fish tank or a spacious parrot cage. Each pet has its own personality, and your dogs and cats can even interact with their environment! With hundreds of pet-related items, you can turn your office into a true pet sanctuary.

A LITTLE BIRD TOLD ME…

Adopt responsibly! Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime!

WHAT’S NEW?

  • a new region of Pinnacove to unlock

  • 40+ dog and cat breeds, some with unique traits

  • 30+ smaller pet species to adopt

  • 10 pawesome jobs to bring the community together

  • 10 unique houses purrfect for animal lovers

  • 4+ buyers with cuddly friends

  • 4+ pet-related item assemblies

  • hundreds of new items (cozy! rustic! mediterranean!)

  • a whole set of challenging new achievements
